stages.title: TWO-AXIS CONTROL

pills.text: TWO-AXIS CONTROL
RELIGIOUS LANGUAGE HAS TWO DISTINCT QUESTIONS
AXIS 1 — MODE OF PREDICATION
AXIS 2 — LOGICAL STATUS
“GOD IS GOOD” MAY BE ANALOGICAL AND COGNITIVE
“I COMMIT MYSELF TO GOD” MAY BE MEANINGFUL WITHOUT
NEVER MERGE HOW WORDS MEAN WITH WHETHER UTTERANCES ASSERT

sequence: RELIGIOUS LANGUAGE HAS TWO DISTINCT QUESTIONS

pills.text: UNIVOCAL, EQUIVOCAL AND ANALOGICAL

CLARITY, BUT RISKS ANTHROPOMORPHISM
WHOLLY DIFFERENT MEANING
PROTECTS TRANSCENDENCE, BUT BLOCKS KNOWLEDGE/INFERENCE
RELATED MEANING GROUNDED IN CAUSAL PARTICIPATION
ANALOGY OF ATTRIBUTION/PROPORTIONALITY; CREATURELY GOODNESS REFLECTS DIVINE SOURCE
SOME UNIVOCAL CONCEPT OF BEING IS NEEDED FOR VALID

FORMS IDENTITY AND DISCLOSES A WORLD OF MEANING UTTERANCES

stages.title: VERIFICATION AND FALSIFICATION

pills.text: VERIFICATION AND FALSIFICATION
COGNITIVELY MEANINGFUL FACTUAL CLAIMS MUST BE ANALYTIC OR EMPIRICALLY
TRADITIONAL GOD-TALK APPEARS MEANINGLESS, NOT MERELY FALSE
ESCHATOLOGICAL VERIFICATION — CELESTIAL-CITY PARABLE; CONFIRMATION MAY OCCUR AFTER
BELIEVERS LET “GOD LOVES US” DIE BY A THOUSAND
RELIGIOUS BLIK IS UNFALSIFIABLE ORIENTATION YET MEANINGFUL
PARTISAN TRUSTS STRANGER DESPITE COUNTER-EVIDENCE; COMMITMENT REMAINS EVIDENTIALLY TESTED
WHAT COUNTS AGAINST THE CLAIM, AND WHAT KIND OF

sequence: AYER: cognitively meaningful factual claims must be analytic or empirically verifiable
traditional God-talk appears meaningless, not merely false
HICK: eschatological verification — celestial-city parable; confirmation may occur after death
FLEW: believers let “God loves us” die by a thousand qualifications
HARE: religious blik is unfalsifiable orientation yet meaningful

ADVANCED-DOSSIER RECONCILIATION — [OPTIONAL ADVANCED]
DOCTRINE STATEMENT.
PREDICATES SUCH AS GOOD AND WISE APPLY TO GOD
(1) CREATURES DEPEND CAUSALLY ON GOD AND DISPLAY PERFECTIONS
(2) EFFECTS RESEMBLE CAUSES WITHOUT MATCHING THEIR MODE
(3) PERFECTION TERMS CAN THEREFORE SIGNIFY TRULY WHILE THEIR
PRESUPPOSITION. CAUTION

groups.heading: OPTIONAL SOURCE WITNESS
items: Advanced-dossier reconciliation — [OPTIONAL ADVANCED]
Doctrine statement.
Predicates such as good and wise apply to God neither in exactly the creaturely sense nor in a wholly unrelated sense, but analogically.
Argument.

groups.heading: ADVANCED OBJECTION
items: (1) Creatures depend causally on God and display perfections
(2) effects resemble causes without matching their mode
(3) perfection terms can therefore signify truly while their mode of possession differs infinitely.
Presupposition. CAUTION: Causal participation warrants semantic continuity and pure perfections can be separated from creaturely limitation.

groups.heading: COMPARATIVE NUANCE
items: Distinction.
Analogy of attribution relates secondary instances to a primary source
proportionality compares relations according to distinct modes of being.
Canonical example.
